encoding: expected is the whole get_recovery_page response envelope. data.bytes is base64 of exactly data.length raw stored bytes at data.offset of the component (its UTF-16LE code units as stored); decode base64 first, then join pages by offset, then decode UTF-16LE.
digestRule: data.digest is lowercase hex SHA-256(u8 tagLength || tag || u64be byteLength || bytes) over the raw page bytes with tag 'senpi-recovery-catalog/1/utf16le/fragment'; component.digest is the same rule over the whole component with domain 'leaf'.
limitsRule: limits.D is the most raw stored bytes one page carries (data.length <= D). limits.envelope is the most characters the base64 data.bytes string of one page can have, ceil(D / 3) * 4; it is NOT a cap on the whole response envelope.
cursorRule: data.cursor is opaque: present it unchanged as the next request's cursor; it is null once data.complete. Its authenticator is keyed per engine process, so these goldens fix that key in the generator; never parse or construct a cursor.
refusalRule: A refusal is success false with error and errorCode 'recovery_<reason>' and errorData {kind, reason, hint}; hint restart_from_catalog means discard the component's pages and request it again without a cursor.
inputRule: input.command is the request without sessionId; every case is sent in file order on one session whose id is session.idRule: prefix + repeat x count + suffix.
